sentence: Hoje não faz sol nem calor.
ipa: ˈɔʒe ˈnɐ̃w̃ ˈfaz ˈsɔɫ ˈnẽ kɐˈloɾ
gloss_en: Today it is neither sunny nor hot.
notes: Velarised coda [ɫ] in 'sol' and open [ɔ] per goncalves2010; weaker-than-EP unstressed vocalism with /ɨ/ largely absent per nhatuve2019.

sentence: O bilhete do machimbombo custa cem meticais.
ipa: u biˈʎɛte du mɐʃĩˈbõbu ˈkustɐ ˈsẽ metiˈkajs
gloss_en: The bus ticket costs a hundred meticais.
notes: Mozambican lexicon 'machimbombo' (bus) and 'metical' (currency) per goncalves1996; palatal [ʎ] in 'bilhete' per goncalves2010.

sentence: Tenho consulta na quinta-feira às nove horas.
ipa: ˈtɛɲu kõˈsuɫtɐ nɐ ˈkĩtɐ ˈfejɾɐ as ˈnɔve ˈɔɾɐs
gloss_en: I have an appointment on Thursday at nine.
notes: Palatal [ɲ] in 'tenho' and dark coda [ɫ] in 'consulta' per goncalves2010; retained /ej/ in 'feira' per nhatuve2019.

sentence: A minha família mora num bairro de Maputo.
ipa: ɐ ˈmiɲɐ fɐˈmiliɐ ˈmɔɾɐ ˈnũ ˈbajru de mɐˈputu
gloss_en: My family lives in a Maputo neighbourhood.
notes: Reference to the prestige Maputo variety per stroud_goncalves1997; alveolar trill [r] from 'rr' in 'bairro' per nhatuve2019; palatal [ɲ] in 'minha' per goncalves2010.

sentence: Vira à direita e segue sempre em frente.
ipa: ˈviɾɐ a diˈɾejtɐ i ˈsɛɡe ˈsẽpre ẽ ˈfrẽte
gloss_en: Turn right and keep going straight ahead.
notes: Retained /ej/ in 'direita' and alveolar trill [r] in the 'fr' cluster of 'frente' per nhatuve2019; imperative register per goncalves2010.

sentence: Esta matapa está muito boa com xima.
ipa: ˈestɐ mɐˈtapɐ esˈta ˈmujtu ˈboɐ kõ ˈʃimɐ
gloss_en: This matapa is very good with maize porridge.
notes: Mozambican dishes 'matapa' and 'xima' per goncalves1996; onset [ʃ] from <x> in 'xima' and open [ɔ] in 'boa' per goncalves2010.

sentence: Onde apanho o chapa para a cidade?
ipa: ˈõde ɐˈpaɲu u ˈʃapɐ ˈpaɾɐ ɐ siˈdade
gloss_en: Where do I catch the minibus to the city?
notes: Mozambican lexicon 'chapa' (minibus) per goncalves1996; palatal [ɲ] in 'apanho' and onset [ʃ] in 'chapa' per goncalves2010.

sentence: Quantos meticais custa o peixe fresco?
ipa: ˈkwɐ̃tos metiˈkajs ˈkustɐ u ˈpejʃe ˈfresku
gloss_en: How many meticais does the fresh fish cost?
notes: Nasal [ɐ̃] in 'quantos', retained /ej/ in 'peixe' and alveolar trill [r] in 'fresco' per nhatuve2019; quantifier interrogative per goncalves2010.

sentence: Se chovesse, ficávamos em casa.
ipa: se ʃoˈvɛs̺e fiˈkavɐmos ẽ ˈkazɐ
gloss_en: If it rained, we would stay home.
notes: [ʃ] onset and open [ɛ] in 'chovesse' per goncalves2010; conditional-imperfect frame per goncalves2010; weak reduction with full [ɛ]/[e] per nhatuve2019.

sentence: Ontem comprei capulana nova no mercado.
ipa: ˈõtẽ kõˈprej kɐpuˈlanɐ ˈnɔvɐ nu merˈkadu
gloss_en: Yesterday I bought a new capulana at the market.
notes: Mozambican lexicon 'capulana' (wrap cloth) per goncalves1996; retained /ej/ in 'comprei' and alveolar trill [r] in 'mercado' per nhatuve2019.

sentence: Para o ano vou viajar até à Beira.
ipa: ˈpaɾɐ u ˈɐnu ˈvo viɐˈʒaɾ ɐˈtɛ a ˈbejɾɐ
gloss_en: Next year I will travel to Beira.
notes: Mozambican place name Beira per goncalves1996; open [ɛ] in 'até', /o/ monophthong in 'vou'->[ˈvo] and retained /ej/ in 'Beira' per nhatuve2019.

sentence: Liga-me mais tarde, por favor.
ipa: ˈliɡɐ me ˈmajs ˈtarde poɾ fɐˈvɔɾ
gloss_en: Call me later, please.
notes: Open [ɔ] in 'por'/'favor' and alveolar trill [r] in 'tarde' per nhatuve2019; clitic imperative 'liga-me' per goncalves2010.

sentence: Olá madala, tudo bem contigo?
ipa: oˈla mɐˈdalɐ ˈtudu ˈbẽ kõˈtiɡu
gloss_en: Hello elder, are you doing well?
notes: Mozambican address 'madala' (elder) per goncalves1996; full vowels [ˈtudu]/[kõˈtiɡu] with weak reduction per nhatuve2019; greeting register per goncalves2010.

sentence: Quem não arrisca, não petisca.
ipa: ˈkẽ ˈnɐ̃w̃ ɐˈriskɐ ˈnɐ̃w̃ peˈtiskɐ
gloss_en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
notes: Alveolar trill [r] from 'rr' in 'arrisca', neutralising the EP uvular contrast, per nhatuve2019; nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'não'; proverb attested in lopes2004.

sentence: O carro do madala ficou na rua molhada.
ipa: u ˈkaru du mɐˈdalɐ fiˈko nɐ ˈruɐ moˈʎadɐ
gloss_en: The elder's car ended up on the wet street.
notes: Mozambican 'madala' (elder) per goncalves1996; alveolar trill [r] from 'rr' in 'carro' and palatal [ʎ] in 'molhada' per nhatuve2019.

sentence: Ele trouxe um ramo de flores roxas.
ipa: ˈele ˈtrose ˈũ ˈramu de ˈflɔɾes ˈrɔʃɐs
gloss_en: He brought a bunch of red flowers.
notes: Strong word-initial trill [r] in 'ramo'/'roxas' and 'ou' diphthong in 'trouxe' per nhatuve2019; open [ɔ] in 'roxas'/'flores' per goncalves2010.

sentence: Gosto maningue desta canja de galinha.
ipa: ˈɡɔstu mɐˈnĩɡe ˈdɛstɐ ˈkɐ̃ʒɐ de ɡɐˈliɲɐ
gloss_en: I really like this chicken broth.
notes: Mozambican intensifier 'maningue' (a lot) per goncalves1996; palatal [ɲ] in 'galinha' and open [ɔ] in 'gosto' per goncalves2010.

sentence: Aquele rapaz vende jornais na esquina.
ipa: ɐˈkɛle rɐˈpaz ˈvẽde ʒorˈnajs nɐ esˈkinɐ
gloss_en: That young man sells newspapers on the corner.
notes: Alveolar trill [r] in 'rapaz' and open [ɛ] in 'aquele' per nhatuve2019; coda /s/ kept alveolar (no chiado) with weak reduction and formal register per goncalves2010.

sentence: O melhor vinho branco vem de outra terra.
ipa: u meˈʎɔɾ ˈviɲu ˈbrɐ̃ku ˈvẽ de ˈotrɐ ˈtɛrɐ
gloss_en: The best white wine comes from elsewhere.
notes: Palatal [ʎ] in 'melhor' and [ɲ] in 'vinho' per goncalves2010; 'ou' diphthong in 'outra' and alveolar trill [r] per nhatuve2019.

sentence: Nunca vi um céu tão azul sobre o Índico.
ipa: ˈnũkɐ ˈvi ˈũ ˈsɛw ˈtɐ̃w̃ ɐˈzuɫ ˈsobre u ˈĩdiku
gloss_en: I never saw such a blue sky over the Indian Ocean.
notes: Nasal diphthong [ɐ̃w̃] in 'tão', open [ɛ] in 'céu' and dark coda [ɫ] in 'azul' per goncalves2010; alveolar trill [r] in 'sobre' per nhatuve2019.
